start.text: You wake up in a dark forest. There's a path to the left and right.

cave.text: You enter a dark cave. You see a treasure chest and a sleeping dragon.

river.text: You reach a river. You see a boat and a bridge.

treasure.text: You open the chest and find gold! You win!

dragon_attack.text: The dragon wakes up and attacks you. You lose!

island.text: You sail to an island and find a mysterious cave.

village.text: You arrive at a friendly village where you rest and eat. You win!

beach.text: You stay on the beach and a storm hits. You lose!
